profile.headline: Software Engineer at Royal Caribbean Group
profile.summary:
"What if today was your last day? What would you do?"

Devoting everyday to improve my craft as if it were my last, I hold this mindset close to my identity. For the past few years, I have dedicated my time to expand my knowledge on Data Engineering and Machine Learning. As a former intern from Squarespace, I assisted in further improving our event pipeline which handles over millions of events per day. I graduated on December 2021 from FIU with a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science.

Currently, I am seeking employment as a Software Engineer to further develop my skills and provide a positive impact to a company. I hope to utilize the knowledge I have developed to create a positive impact on people’s lives and the environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Supporting the growth of application data and event synchronization with Java, Kafka, and Reactor Core, across multiple ship and shore touchpoints.

positions.title: Data Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Influenced the development of an events pipeline with Python, Java, and Kafka, that handles over 60 million events per day, by storing and analyzing user behavior to make decisions on new or existing features across 10+ teams.
• Fixed bugs in the codebase to resolve exceptions within an ingestion microservice, Clanker, that runs within Spring Boot, improving the distributed system which handles 1000s of requests per second.
• Developed exceptions and verifications to promote stability for Drone schema registration and validation to handle 100+ schema.
• Redesigned the codebase of a Bitbucket repository with over 1000 lines to remove repeated logic, and organize the code, which reduced the number of lines by 28.5%.

positions.title: Server
positions.description:
• Trained 5+ new employees to increase efficiency and teamwork within the restaurant which boosted the team collaboration.
• Coordinated with managers and fellow servers on client demands and tasks to maintain an effective environment, assisting with 400+ guests per day.

positions.title: Server
positions.description: • Developed a sense of customer service and multitasking to enhance restaurant performance and guest satisfaction by providing excellent service to 100+ guests per shift during peak hours.

projects.title: Senior Project – Robotics Academy Web Application
projects.description: Improved the user interface and experience of the FIU Robotics Academy website with five teammates for AEC students and professionals learning robotics and automation technologies; built the new features with Laravel, HTML, and CSS.

projects.title: UPE Discover – Artificial Intelligence Research Team
projects.description: Created a low-energy detection pipeline for audio deepfakes with a team of five undergraduates; operated meta data for DFDC dataset with Python.
